answer_1.quote: In this paper, we attempt to fill this knowledge gap by studying the interaction between machine translation (MT), diacritics and diacritization.

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU score with SACREBLEU implementation (Post, 2018) to measure the performance of MT. For diacritization, we adopt diacritization error rate (DER) and word error rate (WER) with implementation details described in Appendix B.
